final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor narrowed the audited position to one that is actually supportable on the existing admissible record, not because any new admissible evidence was added. The same evidence still does not support clean certification: the record shows an unresolved weakness in a named launch use case, an incomplete draft runbook, and policy requiring disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance. But the record does support a narrower outcome: aggregate readiness and rehearsal results can support launch readiness in general, while public risk-management and model-card guidance support deployment with documented limitations rather than zero residual risk. That makes a caveated compliance finding proportional if, and only if, the limitation is treated as a disclosed caveat rather than denied or treated as fully mitigated. The caveat is not itself an unresolved compliance predicate; denying or omitting it would be. Accordingly, compliant_with_caveats is justified, while caveat-free compliance remains unsupported.
remaining_concerns: The loan-modification support slice remains below target in a named launch use case.
The mitigation runbook is still draft and lacks required control elements, including an accountable owner and alert threshold.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which remains in tension with the documented issue until the limitation is expressly disclosed.
There is still no admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance or a completed mitigation package that would support caveat-free certification.
